description: Gold labels for the 40 synthetic tickets in the tickets table (original eval set).
labeler: Claude, from the full ticket text, before any eval run was scored. Spot-check welcome: edit and re-run `npm run eval:report`.

policy.gold_category: Where a senior support engineer would file the ticket (the agent's 7-way enum).
policy.gold_route: escalate if the category is billing, security_abuse, sales_enterprise or bug_report, OR a correct, complete answer needs something the public docs can't provide (account-level inspection, an engineering investigation, a behaviour that contradicts the docs). auto_resolve only when a doc-grounded answer would resolve the ticket.
